integrity: The universal inequality and four-point classification are proved by a positive Haar-character expansion. A finite exact-arithmetic checker independently evaluates 1602 examples; those checks supplement the all-support argument.
limitations: The lower bound may be strict beyond four-point supports. The no-progression symmetry characterization applies only at four points; finite cyclic groups, discrete phases, and dependent phases are excluded. No exhaustive historical-priority certificate or independent validation is claimed.
title: Four-term progressions as the first skewness obstruction for random-phase Fourier fourth moments
